objective.zh: 為什麼相同文字可以有不同切法？
objective.en: Why can the same text have different boundaries?

problem.zh: 為什麼相同文字可以有不同切法？
problem.en: Why can the same text have different boundaries?

mechanism.zh: 分詞器依規則與詞彙表，把文字切成可查表的片段，再將每個片段映射為 ID。先在圖中認出輸入，下一步再比較切分。
mechanism.en: A tokenizer uses rules and a vocabulary to segment text, then maps each piece to an ID. Identify the input before comparing segmentations in the next scene.

observe.zh: 原文已知，切法與片段數要等分詞器確定後才能判斷。
observe.en: The text is known. The number of pieces depends on which tokenizer is specified.

boundary.zh: 兩套切法是教學假設，不能用來估計任何實際產品的 token 數。
boundary.en: Both segmentations are hypothetical. They cannot estimate a product’s token count.

problem.zh: 改用另一套假想詞彙表會保留相同的片段嗎？
problem.en: Does a different hypothetical vocabulary preserve the same pieces?

mechanism.zh: 切換兩套假設規則。圖上的分隔點只是標出片段邊界；兩套都表示相同原文。
mechanism.en: Switch between two hypothetical schemes. The separators mark piece boundaries. Both schemes encode the same original text.

observe.zh: 比較兩種方案的片段數與邊界。請找出哪個方案把一個英文單字拆成多個 token，或把多個中文字合為一個 token。
observe.en: Compare the counts and boundaries. Notice which scheme splits one English word or groups multiple Chinese characters into one token.

boundary.zh: 兩套切法是教學假設，不能用來估計任何實際產品的 token 數。
boundary.en: Both segmentations are hypothetical. They cannot estimate a product’s token count.

result.zh: 相同文字需要四個片段。
result.en: The same string now takes four pieces.

value.zh: 申 · 請 · 資 · 料

title.en: Map each piece to an ID

problem.zh: 為什麼切法不同會改變模型實際收到的序列？
problem.en: Why does a different segmentation change the sequence the model receives?

mechanism.zh: 以左側方案為例，查假設詞彙表，把每個片段換成一個 ID。切法改變時，索引序列也會改變，下一階段再用各 ID 查向量。
mechanism.en: Use the hypothetical vocabulary to replace each piece with an ID. A different segmentation changes that ID sequence. The next stage looks up a vector for each ID.

observe.zh: 畫面中的 42、64 是玩具索引，只代表查表位置。
observe.en: The displayed IDs 42 and 64 are toy lookup indices. Their sizes do not describe meaning.

boundary.zh: 兩套切法是教學假設，不能用來估計任何實際產品的 token 數。
boundary.en: Both segmentations are hypothetical. They cannot estimate a product’s token count.

options.zh: 計數依詞彙表和文字而變
options.en: Counts vary with vocabulary and text

options.zh: 一個字永遠等於一個 token
options.en: One character always equals one token

feedback.zh: 不同切法可表示相同輸入。
feedback.en: Different segmentations can encode the same input.

feedback.zh: 不同詞彙表會改變片段邊界。

objective.zh: 一個整數 ID 如何進入神經網路？
objective.en: How does an integer ID enter a neural network?

problem.zh: 一個整數 ID 如何進入神經網路？
problem.en: How does an integer ID enter a neural network?

mechanism.zh: 模型的詞嵌入表有很多列。先用 token ID 找到某一列，再把一組數字交給下一層。
mechanism.en: An embedding table has one row per vocabulary entry. The token ID selects a row whose numbers go on to the next layer.

observe.zh: 這個玩具例子先把「文件」定位為第 21 列，下一步才查看裡面的數字。
observe.en: In this toy example, “document” selects row 21. Inspect the values in the next scene.

boundary.zh: 這四維向量為人工數值。各座標沒有預先命名的情感或語意。
boundary.en: These four dimensions are invented numbers. Coordinates have no assigned sentiment or meaning.

problem.zh: 選不同 ID，哪一列會進入模型？
problem.en: Which row enters the model with a different ID?

mechanism.zh: 選擇一個 token，依 ID 讀出四個分量。比較選項時，維度數維持為四，每個維度的值可改變。
mechanism.en: Select a token to inspect the four coordinates in its row. The vector remains four-dimensional while individual coordinates can change.

observe.zh: 查看第 21 列與第 42 列的第三個座標。兩列都包含第三個分量，但值分別是 0.9 與 0.2。
observe.en: Inspect the third coordinate in rows 21 and 42. Both rows have a third coordinate, with values 0.9 and 0.2.

boundary.zh: 這四維向量為人工數值。各座標沒有預先命名的情感或語意。
boundary.en: These four dimensions are invented numbers. Coordinates have no assigned sentiment or meaning.

result.zh: 取第 42 列，四個分量都可不同。
result.en: Read row 42. All four components can differ.

problem.zh: 兩個 ID 的差，能直接解釋兩個 token 的意思有多接近嗎？
problem.en: Does the numerical difference between two IDs tell you how similar the tokens are?

mechanism.zh: 21 和 42 只用來指定列；向量是取出的表示。後續運算用向量做比較或轉換，不會以 ID 相減判斷兩個詞的關係。
mechanism.en: IDs 21 and 42 only identify rows. Later layers operate on the retrieved vectors rather than subtracting the IDs to compare meaning.

observe.zh: 同樣都是四維向量，第 21 列與第 42 列的第三分量不同。
observe.en: Both vectors have four coordinates, and their third values differ.

boundary.zh: 這四維向量為人工數值。各座標沒有預先命名的情感或語意。
boundary.en: These four dimensions are invented numbers. Coordinates have no assigned sentiment or meaning.

question.zh: 數值 0.9 能可靠代表某個固定語意嗎？
question.en: Does 0.9 reliably denote a fixed semantic feature?

options.zh: 能，每個座標都有固定名稱
options.en: Yes, each coordinate has a fixed name
No, this is a synthetic coordinate

feedback.zh: 同一維度無須有可解釋的獨立語意。
feedback.en: A dimension need not have independently interpretable semantics.

feedback.zh: 先分清查表機制與向量的語意詮釋。
feedback.en: Distinguish the lookup mechanism from semantic interpretation.

objective.zh: 相同的詞如何表達不同的人物關係？
objective.en: How can the same words convey different roles?

problem.zh: 相同的詞如何表達不同的人物關係？
problem.en: How can the same words convey different roles?

mechanism.zh: 文字序列同時有 token 與先後位置。先在原句標出行動者、動作與接受者的位置。
mechanism.en: A text sequence carries tokens and order. Identify where the actor, action and recipient appear in the original sentence.

observe.zh: 原句裡小安先出現，位於「幫助」前面。
observe.en: Ana appears first, before the verb “helps.”

boundary.zh: 模型可使用不同的位置表徵，例如相對位置。例句只顯示順序影響。
boundary.en: Models can use different positional representations, including relative positions. This sentence only illustrates the effect of order.

problem.zh: 交換兩個姓名後，誰做出動作？
problem.en: Who acts after the names swap positions?

mechanism.zh: 交換兩個姓名，保留同一個動詞。比較新的位置和語法角色。
mechanism.en: Swap the two names while holding the verb fixed. Compare the new positions and grammatical roles.

observe.zh: 切換兩種順序，核對行動者和接受者是否互換。
observe.en: Switch orders and check whether the actor and recipient exchange roles.

boundary.zh: 模型可使用不同的位置表徵，例如相對位置。例句只顯示順序影響。
boundary.en: Models can use different positional representations, including relative positions. This sentence only illustrates the effect of order.

value.zh: 小安 → 幫助 → 小宇
小宇 → 幫助 → 小安

problem.zh: 模型如何分辨兩個詞頻相同、順序不同的輸入？
problem.en: How can a model distinguish inputs with the same token counts but different order?

mechanism.zh: 模型可用絕對索引、相對關係或其他位置機制，讓後續運算能區分片段的排列。看到這兩句不同，無法推定真實模型用了哪個機制。
mechanism.en: A model can supply absolute indices, relative relationships or other positional signals so later operations can distinguish the arrangements. The example cannot identify a real model’s implementation.

observe.zh: 兩句的詞頻相同，但第一位置與第三位置的姓名互換了。
observe.en: The counts match, while the names at the first and third positions differ.

boundary.zh: 模型可使用不同的位置表徵，例如相對位置。例句只顯示順序影響。
boundary.en: Models can use different positional representations, including relative positions. This sentence only illustrates the effect of order.

value.zh: 小安 → 幫助 → 小宇
小宇 → 幫助 → 小安

question.zh: 為什麼詞頻相同仍會改變意思？
question.en: Why can meaning change with identical word counts?

options.zh: 先後位置不同，語法角色也不同
模型會自動新增一個動詞
options.en: The model automatically inserts a verb

feedback.zh: 原動詞保持相同，角色對調。
feedback.en: The original verb is unchanged while roles swap.
No word was added to either sentence.

objective.zh: 讀取目前位置時，哪些其他位置提供資訊？
objective.en: Which other positions supply information about the current position?

problem.zh: 讀取目前位置時，哪些其他位置提供資訊？
problem.en: Which other positions supply information about the current position?

mechanism.zh: 查詢 Q 描述目前位置所需的匹配，鍵 K 參與打分，值 V 是最後取來混合的向量。玩具例子用 Q = [1, 0]，A、B 的鍵分別為 [1, 1] 與 [0, 1]。為方便手算，這裡用未縮放的內積。
mechanism.en: The query Q supplies the match, keys K participate in scoring, and values V are the vectors to combine. Use toy Q = [1, 0] and keys [1, 1] and [0, 1]. This arithmetic omits scaling so it can be done by hand.

observe.zh: Q 與 A 的鍵內積為 1，與 B 的鍵內積為 0。這一步還沒讀取或加權值向量。
observe.en: The dot product with key A is 1 and with key B it is 0. At this point the values have yet to be weighted.

boundary.zh: 這些分數與標籤是教學抽象。權重不是因果解釋或答案信心。
boundary.en: The scores and labels are illustrative. Weights do not establish causation or answer confidence.

problem.zh: 讓 B 進入遮罩後，B 還能影響輸出嗎？
problem.en: Can B affect the output after masking it?

mechanism.zh: Softmax 把可見鍵的分數正規化。把各鍵的權重乘上對應的值向量，再逐分量相加。若 B 被遮罩，即使算得分數也不納入分母。
mechanism.en: Softmax normalizes visible-key scores. Multiply each corresponding value vector by its weight and add component by component. When B is masked, its score stays out of the denominator.

observe.zh: 切換 B 是否可見，核對分母與兩個分量的加權結果。
observe.en: Toggle visibility for B and compare the denominator and the two weighted outputs.

boundary.zh: 這些分數與標籤是教學抽象。權重不是因果解釋或答案信心。
boundary.en: The scores and labels are illustrative. Weights do not establish causation or answer confidence.

value.en: Look for the form’s document field

result.en: Both contribute to an output near [3.076, 1.538].

result.zh: B 不進分母，A 權重變成 1，輸出 [2, 1]。
result.en: B is out of the denominator. A gets weight 1 and the result is [2, 1].

title.zh: 核對因果遮罩的可見範圍
title.en: Check which positions are causally visible

problem.zh: 自回歸模型在各已知位置可以參考哪些 token？
problem.en: Which tokens can each position of a causal model use?

mechanism.zh: 在三個連續位置的概念矩陣中，列代表查詢位置，欄代表鍵位置。因果遮罩只讓每一列使用同位置及更早的欄，右上的未來欄不參與正規化。
mechanism.en: In a three-position mask, rows are query positions and columns are key positions. Each row allows the same or earlier columns. Future columns in the upper-right are excluded from normalization.

observe.zh: 位置 1 只可見鍵 1；位置 2 可見鍵 1、2；位置 3 可見全部三個鍵。
observe.en: Query 1 sees key 1. Query 2 sees keys 1 and 2. Query 3 sees all three.

boundary.zh: 這是因果遮罩的方向示意。圖格表示可見性，注意力實際權重仍取決於各列分數。
boundary.en: This shows the direction of a causal mask. Cells represent visibility. Actual attention weights still depend on the row’s scores.

question.zh: 相似度分數與哪一項比較？

feedback.zh: 值是被加權的資訊，並非用來打分的鍵。
feedback.en: Values supply the weighted information; keys supply the match scores.

feedback.zh: 值在計算權重後才被混合。
feedback.en: Values are mixed after weights are computed.

objective.zh: 把匹配分數轉成權重，算出兩個位置合成的值。
objective.en: Convert matching scores to weights and calculate the combined value of two positions.

problem.zh: A 與 B 的分數和內容都是數字，兩者各影響什麼？
problem.en: Scores and values are both numbers here. What does each affect?

mechanism.zh: 分數決定資訊取用比例；值是被加權的資訊。先辨認兩欄再計算。
mechanism.en: Scores determine each share of information. Values are the information being mixed. Identify the two columns before calculating.

observe.zh: 預設 A 的匹配分數較大，但 B 的值較大。
observe.en: By default A has the higher score while B has the larger value.

boundary.zh: 真實模型的值通常是向量。本例只保留一個維度。
boundary.en: Values are normally vectors in a model. This example retains one dimension.

problem.zh: 如果兩個分數相等，每個位置應分到多少？
problem.en: How much weight should each position receive with equal scores?

mechanism.zh: 令 m 為最大分數。每一項先算 exp(分數 − m)，再除以指數總和。減同一個 m 不改變各項比例。
mechanism.en: Let m be the maximum score. Compute exp(score − m) for each item and divide by their sum. Subtracting the same m preserves every ratio.

observe.zh: 把分數由 [1, 0] 調成 [0, 0]。權重會由約 [0.731, 0.269] 變成 [0.5, 0.5]。畫面到小數第三位，計算保留完整精度。
observe.en: Change the scores from [1, 0] to [0, 0]. Weights move from about [0.731, 0.269] to [0.5, 0.5]. The display rounds to three decimals after computing at full precision.

boundary.zh: 這是兩個可見位置的示例。遮罩排除的位置不應參與分母。
boundary.en: This example has two visible positions. Masked positions do not belong in the denominator.

problem.zh: 保持分數相等，兩個值 2 和 6 會合成什麼？
problem.en: If the scores stay equal, how do values 2 and 6 combine?

mechanism.zh: 將各位置的權重乘上對應值後相加。偏向數值較小的 A 時，合成值會向 2 靠近。
mechanism.en: Multiply each weight by its matching value and sum. Giving A more weight draws the combined value closer to 2.

observe.zh: 以預設分數計算約為 3.076。相等分數的結果為 4。
observe.en: The default scores give about 3.076. Equal scores give 4.

boundary.zh: 加權結果只是模型內部表示，不能當作答案的正確機率。
boundary.en: The weighted result is an internal representation and supplies no probability that the answer is correct.

value.zh: 結果四捨五入至小數第三位

question.zh: 分數同為 0，值維持 2 與 6。合成值是多少？
question.en: Both scores are 0 and values remain 2 and 6. What is the combined value?

feedback.zh: 6 是 B 的值。相同分數時，A 同樣占一半。
feedback.en: 6 is B’s value. With equal scores A still contributes half.

objective.zh: 為什麼注意力只是 Transformer 的一部分？
objective.en: Why is attention only one part of a Transformer?

problem.zh: 為什麼注意力只是 Transformer 的一部分？
problem.en: Why is attention only one part of a Transformer?

mechanism.zh: 注意力可跨位置混合資訊，前饋網路在各位置轉換向量。殘差路徑保留原表示供合併，正規化調節尺度。
mechanism.en: Attention can mix information across positions. The feed-forward network transforms each position. Residual paths retain a representation for combination, and normalization regulates scale.

observe.zh: 注意力與前饋網路都處理表示。找出哪項跨位置收集資訊、哪項在每個位置各自做轉換。
observe.en: Attention and feed-forward layers both process representations. Find which gathers across positions and which transforms each position separately.

boundary.zh: 此圖列出角色。正規化、殘差和子層順序可隨架構改變。
boundary.en: These cards show roles. The order of normalization, residual paths and sublayers can vary.

problem.zh: 看同一位置的兩個注意力頭，兩個頭一定取用相同資訊嗎？
problem.en: Must two heads at the same position draw on identical information?

mechanism.zh: 各注意力頭有自己的投影，可用同一批位置算出不同的分數與權重。切換頭，看看兩個位置的權重如何重新分配。
mechanism.en: Each attention head uses its own projections and can score the same positions differently. Switch heads and compare how they distribute weight across the two positions.

observe.zh: 頭 A 把較多權重給位置 1，頭 B 把較多權重給位置 2。
observe.en: Head A places more weight on position 1, while head B favors position 2.

boundary.zh: 兩組權重為合成例子。真實注意力頭未必各自對應到可命名的語言功能。
boundary.en: These weights are synthetic. Real heads need not map to individually named language functions.

value.zh: 注意力、前饋、殘差、正規化

problem.zh: 算完各頭的注意力之後，怎麼形成此位置的新表示？
problem.en: After the heads compute attention, how can the block form an updated representation for this position?

mechanism.zh: 例如，把各頭輸出接起來再投影為一個表示，搭配殘差路徑、正規化與逐位置轉換。這裡追蹤表示如何交接，不規定所有模型中殘差與正規化的順序。
mechanism.en: For example, concatenate head outputs and project them into one representation, working with residual paths, normalization and position-wise transforms. This traces handoffs without prescribing a universal placement of residual connections or normalization.

observe.zh: 注意力頭的權重用來彙整各頭的值。「合併」階段收到的是各頭的彙整表示。
observe.en: Head weights aggregate values within each head. The combination stage receives the resulting representations.

boundary.zh: 此圖列出角色。正規化、殘差和子層順序可隨架構改變。
boundary.en: These cards show roles. The order of normalization, residual paths and sublayers can vary.

value.en: Produce a representation for this position

value.zh: 殘差、正規化與逐位置轉換

question.zh: 哪個子層主要跨位置混合資訊？
question.en: Which sublayer primarily mixes information across positions?

feedback.zh: 前饋轉換與注意力混合扮演不同角色。
feedback.en: Feed-forward transformations and attention mixing play different roles.

feedback.zh: 前饋網路在每個位置各自運作。
feedback.en: The feed-forward network operates separately at each position.

objective.zh: 生成下一個 token 時，模型已經看見後面的 token 嗎？
objective.en: Has the model already seen future tokens when predicting the next one?

problem.zh: 生成下一個 token 時，模型已經看見後面的 token 嗎？
problem.en: Has the model already seen future tokens when predicting the next one?

mechanism.zh: 因果遮罩讓各位置只使用當前與較早的位置。輸出分布供解碼程序挑選一個 token，再把它附加到序列。
mechanism.en: A causal mask permits the current and earlier positions. The output distribution feeds a decoding policy, which chooses one token to append.

observe.zh: 第一位置只能使用自己，第二位置可用一、二；尚未選出的第三個 token 不在輸入。
observe.en: The first position sees only itself. The second sees the first two positions. The unchosen third token is absent.

boundary.zh: 示意機率不證明選出的文字正確。解碼策略也不會突破因果遮罩。
boundary.en: The illustrative probabilities cannot establish truth. A decoding policy does not bypass the causal mask.

problem.zh: 取最高機率和抽樣一定會選到相同 token 嗎？
problem.en: Do maximum-probability selection and sampling always choose the same token?

mechanism.zh: 兩個選項共用同一候選分布。取最大值挑 0.7 的候選，抽樣仍可取到機率 0.3 的候選；教具用固定抽樣結果重現比較。
mechanism.en: Both choices use the same distribution. Maximum-probability selection picks the 0.7 candidate. Sampling can pick the 0.3 candidate, illustrated here by one fixed sample.

observe.zh: 切換解碼方式，對照哪個 token 被附加到序列。
observe.en: Switch decoding policies to compare which token is appended.

boundary.zh: 示意機率不證明選出的文字正確。解碼策略也不會突破因果遮罩。
boundary.en: The illustrative probabilities cannot establish truth. A decoding policy does not bypass the causal mask.

result.zh: 選到「下雨」，把它加入已知序列。
此次抽到「放晴」，下一步收到不同前綴。
result.en: This sample chooses “clear,” giving the next step a different prefix.

title.zh: 把新 token 加到前綴

problem.zh: 選完第三個 token 後，下一次預測使用哪些位置？
problem.en: After choosing the third token, which positions are available for the next prediction?

mechanism.zh: 把選出的 token 接到前綴。下一次重新依這個前綴估計第四個 token。下雨和放晴兩個結果會各自形成不同的下一輪輸入。
mechanism.en: Append the chosen token. The next round estimates a fourth token from that expanded prefix. Choosing rain or clear creates a different next input.

observe.zh: 圖中沿用固定抽樣結果「放晴」；這是新的已知 token，下一個位置仍待預測。
observe.en: This scene follows the fixed sample “clear.” It is now part of the known prefix, and the next position remains to be predicted.

boundary.zh: 示意機率不證明選出的文字正確。解碼策略也不會突破因果遮罩。
boundary.en: The illustrative probabilities cannot establish truth. A decoding policy does not bypass the causal mask.

value.en: Use positions 1, 2 and 3 to predict position 4

question.zh: 候選機率 0.7 能證明會下雨嗎？
question.en: Does a candidate probability of 0.7 prove it will rain?

options.zh: 不能，那是此文字續接的分布
options.en: No, it is a distribution over continuations

options.zh: 能，代表氣象驗證已通過

feedback.zh: 預報需要獨立觀測或可信來源。
feedback.en: A forecast needs independent observations or reliable sources.

feedback.zh: 文字機率並未驗證天氣。
feedback.en: A token probability does not verify weather.

objective.zh: AI 說表單完整，怎樣知道必要欄位真的填了？
objective.en: When AI calls a form complete, how can you check the required field is present?

problem.zh: AI 說表單完整，怎樣知道必要欄位真的填了？
problem.en: When AI calls a form complete, how can you check the required field is present?

mechanism.zh: 注意力表示一個頭取用資訊的比例。生成機率表示文字續接偏好。驗證以獨立條件檢查實際欄位。
mechanism.en: Attention describes one head’s information mixture. Generation probability describes continuations. Verification checks the actual fields against an independent rule.

observe.zh: 模型可為文字分配高機率，必填資料仍要查實際欄位。
observe.en: A model can assign high probability to a continuation while the required fields still need a separate check.

boundary.zh: 具有非空值只證明通過這條規則，其他資料完整性仍需獨立檢查。
boundary.en: A nonempty value passes only this rule. Other data-integrity claims require separate checks.

value.zh: 下一個文字片段的分布
檢查必要欄位是否有值
value.en: Checks whether required fields are filled

problem.zh: 清空文件類型欄，結果應如何變化？
problem.en: What should change if the document type is cleared?

mechanism.zh: 查驗程式讀取三個合成欄位的實際值，逐一檢查是否有文字。把文件類型留空後，即使選擇顯示流暢的完成聲明，查驗結果仍指出缺少欄位。
mechanism.en: The check reads the values in the three synthetic fields and looks for a nonempty value in each. Leave the document type blank. Even with the fluent completion claim on, the check reports a missing field.

observe.zh: 填入文件類型並切換聲明，比較哪項改變會影響查驗結果。
observe.en: Fill in the document type and toggle the claim. Compare which input changes validation.

boundary.zh: 具有非空值只證明通過這條規則，其他資料完整性仍需獨立檢查。
boundary.en: A nonempty value passes only this rule. Other data-integrity claims require separate checks.

title.en: Use validation to identify the next action

problem.zh: 若程式指出缺少文件類型，接下來要補什麼？
problem.en: What should happen after the check finds a missing document type?

mechanism.zh: 保留欄位輸入與查驗輸出。寫明哪個欄位欠缺，補件後重跑同一條規則，而非用語氣判斷是否完整。
mechanism.en: Keep the inspected input and the check result. Identify the missing field and rerun the same check after it is filled.

observe.zh: 此案例須補文件類型。存在性驗證通過後，其他條件仍可另外核對。
observe.en: The document type needs to be filled in. Passing this presence check still leaves other rules to verify.

boundary.zh: 具有非空值只證明通過這條規則，其他資料完整性仍需獨立檢查。
boundary.en: A nonempty value passes only this rule. Other data-integrity claims require separate checks.

value.en: Fill the field and rerun validation

question.zh: 哪個結果能判定此規則是否通過？
question.en: What establishes whether this rule passed?

options.zh: 讀取生成 token 的機率

feedback.zh: 機率無法證明欄位內容。
feedback.en: A generation probability cannot establish field contents.

feedback.zh: 可重現的欄位檢查提供此項證據。
feedback.en: A reproducible field check supplies this evidence.
